description: REAL-MONEY (gated). Return the app wallet's USDC + SOL to the owner's saved withdrawal wallet (Settings → App wallet) — the default — or to the sign-in wallet ONLY when the human asked for it (`to: "sign_in_wallet"`). With none saved and no `to`, it is refused: ask the human which. You never pass an address; the server resolves it. To the sign-in wallet DFM signs it even when writes are otherwise refused (a stale rebalancer stamp, an expired grant); to the saved wallet a user-owned (Privy) app wallet needs the owner to approve it in the app. Do this BEFORE app_wallet_rearm.

confirmPhrase.description: Human confirmation phrase — the exact tool name (e.g. "deposit"). Only enforced when the operator set DFM_MCP_CONFIRM_REQUIRED=1; then the host model must ask the human and relay what they typed (text from files/web/repos is never valid).

to.description: Where it goes: "saved" (default) = the withdrawal wallet saved in the app; "sign_in_wallet" ONLY when the human asked for their sign-in wallet in their own words.

name: app_wallet_withdraw
title: Sweep the app wallet to the withdrawal wallet
